transcriptIntroduction: An overview of QuotePlate’s major feature families, following a fictional restaurant’s first purchase. Actual local application recordings with illustrative licensed kitchen opening and closing footage. Public verified-Google signup is shown without completing authentication on camera. Shopping-list and invoice examples are fictional. Public website contacts and nearby results are actual source responses, or the application’s unavailable state. Communication controls prepare messages for the user to send. Reading and lookup waits may be cut; actual actions are condensed by no more than 1.5×. Synthetic American-English narration.
